verdict.rationale: Deel's own docs say it pays contractors in 150+ countries with compliant payroll and automated compliance. Its API documents a dedicated endpoint for creating contractor contracts. Nothing in the evidence explicitly says contractors are paid in their local currencies, and a community report says contractors were pushed toward a Deel Wallet payout. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of local-currency payouts, detail on contract compliance (e.g., local-law templates or misclassification protection), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can pay international contractors in their local currencies with compliant contracts

citations.quote: Run accurate, compliant payroll for employees, contractors, and EOR workers across 150+ countries with unified data, automated compliance, and real-time cost visibility.
Pay every worker type, in every country, from one platform.
